title: Split Array Largest Sum
statement:
Given an array of N non-negative integers and an integer K, split the array into K contiguous subarrays such that the maximum sum among these K subarrays is minimized.

Return this minimized maximum sum.

If N < K, return -1.

Use binary search on the answer, similar to allocating pages. The search space is [max(A), sum(A)].
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and K.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimized largest sum.

examples.explanation: Split into [7,2,5] (sum 14) and [10,8] (sum 18). Minimized max is 18.
Each element in its own subarray.
